interface.longDescription: Diagnose gaps across the home service lead-to-job journey and produce a practical improvement blueprint. For home service owners and teams. Delivers editable company-branded Markdown plus styled HTML, evidence labels and an internally usable implementation blueprint. Matches verified website branding or owner-selected trade palettes. Qualitative findings are valid when data is missing. Conditional financial opportunity is not guaranteed. Plans and drafts only; no live integrations, automatic outreach, calendar changes or monitoring. AI Growth Studio is the developer; optional implementation support is separate from the audit.
